subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Team Building Retreat
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce our upcoming Annual Team Building Retreat scheduled for next month. The retreat will be held at a beautiful resort and will include team-building activities, workshops, and plenty of time for relaxation and bonding. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details regarding accommodations and the itinerary. We look forward to a productive and enjoyable retreat together! Best regards, [Your Name]
